Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi !
(its "question night" i guess)

To which extent equipment cannot be used in combat when opposing vampire
plays Drawing out the beast ?

because "cannot *use* equipment" is quite ambiguous.

guess i cannot burn Blood tears to prevent damage or gain blood ?
guess hand of conrad has no effect (quite strange)

how can then the soul gem take effect if the bearer is burned in combat when
drawing out the beast has been played ?

thank you
reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
reyda wrote:
> To which extent equipment cannot be used in combat when opposing vampire
> plays Drawing out the beast ?

To every extent.

> because "cannot *use* equipment" is quite ambiguous.

I do not agree.

> guess i cannot burn Blood tears to prevent damage or gain blood ?

Right.

> guess hand of conrad has no effect (quite strange)

Right.

> how can then the soul gem take effect if the bearer is burned in combat when
> drawing out the beast has been played ?

Because the vampire is burned already, so it is clearly not the case that
the vampire is "using" the equipment (burned vampires cannot use equipment).

Messages.Author: Talonz
Messages.Body:
"reyda" <true_...@hotmail.com> wrote in message news:<3d927023$0$5924$79c1...@nan-newsreader-01.noos.net>...

I know you're waiting for LSJ but I thought I'd way in here;

> To which extent equipment cannot be used in combat when opposing vampire
> plays Drawing out the beast ?
>
> because "cannot *use* equipment" is quite ambiguous.
>
> guess i cannot burn Blood tears to prevent damage or gain blood ?

That would be its only function and therefore that would be 'using'
it.

> guess hand of conrad has no effect (quite strange)
>

The hand bearing minion forgets about what his hand can do in his
beast induced state?

> how can then the soul gem take effect if the bearer is burned in combat when
> drawing out the beast has been played ?
>

Soul gem would trigger once the minion was burned and therefore once
combat had ended.

.02$
